# Phoenix Delta LLC

> Phoenix Delta LLC ("Installation and Repair") is a new home installation and repair company serving Jacksonville, Florida and the surrounding areas. One call for many jobs. Phone: 904-562-9356.

## Key facts
- Business type: home installation and repair, multi-service (HomeAndConstructionBusiness)
- Service area: Jacksonville, FL and surrounding areas, including Duval, Clay, St. Johns and Nassau counties. Service-area business, no public storefront address.
- Phone: 904-562-9356 (estimate requests can be sent by text from the Contact page)
- Interior remodeling is non-licensed work only; work requiring a state-licensed trade is not offered.
- The company is new: no reviews, ratings, prices, hours or email are published yet.

## Services
- Interior finishes: Painting; Plastering; Caulking
- Interior remodeling: Interior remodeling; Cabinetry; Handyman services
- Floors, tile & stone: Flooring; Decorative stone & tile
- Exterior surfaces: Stuccoing; Pressure washing
- Driveways & courts: Driveway installation; Tennis court installation
- Awnings & ornamental iron: Canvas awnings; Ornamental iron
